summary: Stack-based SPFA can incorrectly report a negative cycle in an acyclic graph because repeated vertex processing reaches its visit limit. The fix uses a FIFO VecDeque instead. The added tests/spfa.rs test spfa_no_neg_cycle exercises this behavior. Blocked under the single-file reversal schema: restoring the parent implementation in src/algo/spfa.rs changes spfa_loop's queue parameter to Vec, requiring the corresponding reversal in src/algo/johnson.rs, whose unconditionally compiled caller supplies VecDeque. Reversing only queue operations instead leaves unsupported VecDeque push/pop calls. A valid verbatim reversal requires both implementation files. No builds or tests were run.
